sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Albarracín is a sandstone bouldering destination in a forested setting near Teruel.

sections.heading: History and context
warnings: No sourced history and context content found for this pass.

sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: The source supports sandstone bouldering; the legacy packet adds overhangs, slabs, crimps and roofs across forest sectors.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: The legacy packet says there are problems of many difficulties and styles, but it is not precise enough for a numeric gradeRange.

sections.heading: Grades and difficulty
sections.body: Climb Europe reports that the Boulder Albarracín guidebook details over 1,600 problems; gradeRange remains null.

sections.heading: Season and conditions
sections.body: The legacy packet supports late autumn to early spring friction, with spring and autumn as practical best-season tags and winter as a caution because nights can be far below zero.

sections.heading: Transport and access
sections.body: The legacy packet identifies Valencia and Alicante airport access and recommends hiring a car.

sections.heading: Where to stay
